title: The Intel 1103: The MOS memory that defied cores
lineage: Contemporary Electronics magazine profile reports an introductory $60 chip price and an Intel manager’s estimate of six million units shipped in 1973 at $4 average price. Estimate is a forecast, not observed sales.
